title: Raw triangle pullback composition with arbitrary derived coefficient maps
statement: For a commutative ring Λ, schemes X,Y,Z,S, morphisms a:X→Y,b:Y→Z,h:Z→S,hy:Y→S,hx:X→S with b≫h=hy and a≫hy=hx, any integer q, bounded-below derived module sheaves K on Z,L on Y,M on X [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and arbitrary coefficient maps v:D⁺(b*)K→L and w:D⁺(a*)L→M, raw triangle pullback [sbc-lem-higher-image-raw-triangle-restriction] along a≫b with coefficient (upperStarPlusComp a b).hom.app K ≫ D⁺(a*).map v ≫ w agrees on every class z at every U in S.Etale with the successive raw triangle pullbacks along b with v and a with w. The composition comparison is canonical [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. This statement does not identify the restricted single-complex coefficient maps.

proof.text: Substitute wy and wx to normalize hy=b≫h and hx=a≫b≫h. Use the proved private rawTriangleMap_comp calculation, stated over arbitrary categories, functors, single-comparison isomorphisms, and a shift-compatible composition isomorphism. Its statement preserves rawTriangleMap and comparison-isomorphism heads so that the concrete derived-category specialization does not normalize localized morphism projections.

Instantiate sourceComp from AbelianRawPullbackComposition at ModuleCat Λ, h, b, a, and the free sheaf on U. This supplies exactly the source-factor equality required by rawTriangleMap_comp. sourceComp is already proved generically for Grothendieck abelian coefficient categories and uses inverse-single naturality, upperStarComp associativity, and the proved single-comparison composition calculations.

Install NatTrans.CommShift for upperStarPlusComp.hom by composing the proved Functor.plusNatIso_commShift and Functor.plusCompIso_commShift instances from AbelianDerivedDirectImageTransitionShift. These apply to module sheaves and arbitrary bounded-below complexes.

In the generic rawTriangleMap_comp proof, expand rawTriangleMap, distribute the outer functor over composition, move the inner coefficient map through the outer commShiftIso by naturality, and rewrite the source-factor equality. Naturality of the composition comparison at z replaces the iterated pullback by the composite pullback. NatTrans.shift_app_comm, expanded with commShiftIso_comp_hom_app, identifies the remaining shift factors. Functoriality of shift combines the coefficient maps. Instantiate with K,L,M,v,w,q,z; no single-complex presentation or invertibility of coefficient maps is assumed.

lean.statement:
theorem higherDirectImageRawTrianglePullback_comp
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Y Z S : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : X ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ S) (hy : Y ⟶ S) (hx : X ⟶ S)
    (wy : b ≫ h = hy) (wx : a ≫ hy = hx) (q : ℤ)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (M : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (v : D+((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K ⟶ L)
    (w : D+((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj L ⟶ M)
    (U : S.Etale) (z : (higherDirectImagePresheaf Λ h q K).obj (op U)) :
    higherDirectImageRawTrianglePullback Λ (a ≫ b) h hx
        (by rw [Category.assoc, wy, wx]) q K M
        ((upperStarPlusComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) a b).hom.app K ≫
          D+((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map v ≫ w) U z =
      higherDirectImageRawTrianglePullback Λ a hy hx wx q L M w U
        (higherDirectImageRawTrianglePullback Λ b h hy wy q K L v U z)
